claims.assertion: Yazhi says stars and living beings exist across all densities at once; density is the observer’s perception, not a separate location.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: Her model treats densities as perceptions.

claims.assertion: She describes dimensions as increasing complexity or data perceived with consciousness; broader perspectives can encompass simpler ones, and knowledge broadens perception.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi links density-frequency with perceived physical dimensions, saying expanded understanding changes what people perceive; becoming 5D is an individual shift, not an awaited event.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She distinguishes earlier explanations by perspective.
